PluginData.Tooltip: Test only: closes the window while leaving a server
PluginData.Description: Test only, for tests/save-progress-box/rig.py of the Bugfixes plugin. A file savebox-probe.txt in the game's user data folder makes the probe exit to the main menu and raise the window close request during the unload, which leaves the save progress box on the main menu. It writes what it saw to savebox-probe-done.txt.
